## About
Our company is run by Scott Westra, who was born and raised in Texas. Scott oversees every job himself. He sets appointments, completes roof inspections and meets with the adjusters. He doesn't subcontract his work out, and he has had the same crew for years.
We want you to understand your roof so you can make an informed decision about the best fix for you, not what makes us the most money. There is no high pressure sales pitch here. Most of our work today comes from referrals, and we work hard to keep it that way.
We carry a full line of insurance and will gladly give you a Certificate of Insurance. Our customers have given us a 5 star rating across 47 Google reviews.

## Services
- Free storm damage roof inspection: After hail or high winds, we get up on the roof and check for damage at no charge.
- Storm damage claim help: We guide you through the claim, review it with you and work to get fair market value so you can repair the damage to pre-storm condition.
- Roof repairs and re-roofs: From small repairs to full re-roofs, every job gets the same standard of workmanship.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for a roof inspection?
A: No. Call us to set up a free roof assessment.

Q: Can I see proof that you carry insurance?
A: Yes. We carry a full line of insurance and will gladly give you a Certificate of Insurance.
